slip: I pay you to climb, not to slip!
I skied better at age six!
If I slip, I'm docking it from your tip!
high_tension: Why is that rope trembling? Is trembling normal?
Don't YOU let go, let the other one let go!
I weigh exactly right! The gym sculpted me.
Is this rope brand-name or did you give me the old one?
Such tension! You can tell I'm a demanding client.
bird_hit: That bird looked at me wrong first!
Up here, wildlife works for ME! I like it.
If one feather touches me, I'm suing!
A condor wouldn't dare! And I'm such easy prey.
What useful little animals! They picked me.
camp_arrival: Finally! Is there no elevator here?
Where's the camp spa? It was promised.
What a view! Almost as good as my penthouse.
Write this down: I arrived first. Well, with help.
Are we done? I'd barely started suffering.
idle_too_long: Are we moving in up here, or what?
My grandma climbs the attic ladder faster.
Is that the plan, or are you downloading an app?
I pay for climbing minutes, not museum minutes.
fall: MY BODY IS NOT PREPARED FOR THIS SPEED!
I'm telling this story at the company dinner!
Did anyone note that the rope is to blame?
My lawyers will be speaking with gravity!
unbalanced_rope: Why am I hanging sideways? I'm a trophy, not a crooked painting!
Level my elegance, it cost money!
One of you weighs more than you look. Not saying who.
My neck feels this, and my neck trades on the market!
Can the lower team try a tiny bit harder?
sherpa_help: Thanks for the save. It's on the tip… if there is one.
Good work! I'd hire you again. One of you, at least.
See? Together we're unstoppable. Mostly me.
This was teamwork: I hung, you pulled.
Add one more favor to the list I'll never say out loud.
eating: Altitude opens the appetite. It's science.
A snack, please. I keep my figure by hanging.
Eating while hanging burns calories. Net ones.
This is an energy bar. Fiscally speaking.
Don't stare. The leader's food is sacred.
trash: The mountain picks up the trash. It's vertical recycling.
I'm done! The wrapper flies free.
Where do I throw it? There's plenty of room below.
If it hits someone, it means we were doing great.
pee: What was that? Nothing. A jet of victory.
Careful with the handholds down there.
Hotels have pipes for this. Show-offs.
boxes_fell: THOSE BOXES WERE WORTH MORE THAN YOU!
CONSEQUENCES! NO TIP WHEN WE GET DOWN!
condor_angry: GET THAT BIRD OFF! WE ARE FRAGILE!
THIS IS A PLANK, NOT A NEST!
